title: Nothing waits on Windows
goal: No backlog item waits on the Windows host: the kb-tests-windows job finishes within its limit and names its results on the docker-windows runner (6 CPUs, 12 GB per container), kbingest resolves no mapper tool from the working folder and reads git's link mode for global.json on Windows, the PowerShell raw-read hint knows assignments and -Path:value, tests of Windows path handling plant a directory separator, and a clean local account on the Windows host goes from no Python through every /kb-setup environment step that needs no Claude Code sign-in, on record.
